items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Quite naturally, Pops-- Louie Armstrong. ... He's more powerful than Louie, yeah, he was more powerful than anybody I ever knew.

ctx.x: Was he one that you say impressed you?
Yeah, Roy Eldridge, Red Allen. Oh, boy. Quite naturally, Pops-- Louie Armstrong.
When did you first hear Dizzy? Did you hear him when he was with Earl's band, you know, after you had left?
